# Agentable?

> AI Agent Readiness Auditor — audit any website for compatibility with AI agents across L0–L5 levels.

Source: https://seo4agent.com

## What is Agentable?

Agentable audits websites across 24 checks organized into 6 levels of AI agent readiness:
- L0 Hostile: basic reachability and blocking
- L1 Readable: HTML structure, meta tags, SSR
- L2 Discoverable: robots.txt, sitemap, llms.txt, OpenAPI, security.txt
- L3 Interactive: agent card, JSON API, rate limits
- L4 Integrated: MCP server, webhooks, auth, WebMCP, x402
- L5 Autonomous: SSE streaming, subscription API, agent manifest

## Features

- [Audit](https://seo4agent.com/register) — free one-shot audit with L0-L5 scoring
- [Compare](https://seo4agent.com/compare) — compare up to 4 sites side by side
- [Badge](https://seo4agent.com/badge/yourdomain.com) — embeddable SVG badge for your README
- [llms.txt Generator](https://seo4agent.com) — auto-generate llms.txt from your site content

## API

- Badge SVG: GET https://seo4agent.com/badge/{domain}
- Generate llms.txt: POST https://seo4agent.com/generate/llms-txt {"url": "https://example.com"}
- OpenAPI docs: https://seo4agent.com/docs
